rationale: C24, C04, and C16 are the strongest topical matches because they concern enlistments in the armed forces, but the supplied text shows only an identical routine implementation clause directing department secretaries to carry out each order. The child instead rests on a determination that the Ready Reserve strength of the Army Reserve and Marine Corps Reserve cannot be maintained at the level necessary for national defense. No candidate supplies distinctive shared language, a parallel operative sequence, or demonstrably similar legal machinery for authorizing Ready Reserve enlistments. The other candidates concern materially different military personnel actions or unrelated subjects.
